name: year
description: First calendar year of the Australian financial year the figure describes, so 1970 for 1970-71
observations: Partition column. The Australian financial year runs 1 July to 30 June

name: financial_year
description: Australian financial year the figure describes, written as published

name: release_id
description: Identifier of the fiscal release the figure was published in
observations: Each release republishes the whole series back to 1970-71 on its own basis. An earlier release is never overwritten by a later one: both were correct as at their own date

name: release_label
description: Name of the fiscal release as Treasury refers to it

name: release_type
description: Kind of fiscal release: budget or final_budget_outcome
observations: MYEFO publishes no historical-data statement and so appears in payment_growth but not here

name: release_financial_year
description: Australian financial year the release itself is named for
observations: Two Budgets were delivered for 2022-23, in March and again in October after the election, so this does not identify a release on its own

name: sector
observations: general_government for every measure; the two wider sectors appear only in the by-sector tables

name: estimate_type
description: Whether the year is a realised outcome or a projection
observations: Read from the (e) marker Treasury prints against projected years, not inferred from the release date. Final Budget Outcome releases carry outcomes only

name: source_tables
description: Historical-data tables the row was built from, comma separated
observations: Table numbers within the release: 11.1 to 11.11 in most Budgets, 10.1 to 10.11 in the 2022-23 March and 2025-26 Budgets, B.1 to B.11 in every Final Budget Outcome

name: value_aud_million
description: Value in millions of Australian dollars of the day
observations: Left blank where the measure is not published in dollars for that year. The measurement unit is empty because the backend has no AUD unit; values are nominal millions exactly as Treasury publishes them, not deflated

name: value_percent_gdp
description: Value as a percentage of nominal gross domestic product

name: value_percent_real_growth
description: Real growth on the previous year, in per cent
observations: Published only for payments, and only from the year the series begins

name: value_aud_per_person_real
description: Value per person in real Australian dollars of the release's own base year
observations: From the real per capita table, whose base year is the release's own, so figures are comparable within a release and not across releases. The measurement unit is empty because the backend has no AUD unit
